WITH subcategory_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p."Category",
        p."Subcategory",
        SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS revenue,
        SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS units_sold,
        SUM(s."Sales Amount") - SUM(s."Total Product Cost") AS gross_profit

),

    FROM subcategory_stats
    GROUP BY "Category"
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        sc."Category",
        sc."Subcategory",
        sc.revenue,
        sc.units_sold,
        sc.gross_profit,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc."Category" ORDER BY sc.revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank,
